== Notes ==
* Works well with [[build]]s that have monk [[upkeep|maintained enchantments]] (see [[Emo]]).
* The healing from Ether Renewal happens before the [[health loss]] from skills like [[Infuse Health]] and [[Illusion of Weakness]].
* Can be maintained when used with [[Glyph of Swiftness]] and an [[of Enchanting]] weapon.
{{bug|Contrary to the descriptions, this skill causes healing and not [[health gain]].}}
